key_points.point: The document asserts that DCOP frameworks can be used to formalize and audit multi-agent collusion by disentangling task specifications, interaction structures, and execution traces. key_points.verbatim: Importantly, regret-based metrics provided by COLOSSEUM can reveal anomalies missed by message-log judges and can effectively audit LLMs' collusive ability.

This creates a mismatch between the nominal objective and the effective objective optimized by the coalition, making collusion auditable as a measurable drop in system performance.
